rci1_using_msad.detail: HCP-D is a multi-site dataset collected at 4 sites (Washington University, University of Minnesota, Harvard, UCLA) using harmonized 3T Siemens Prisma scanners, per the cited Somerville et al. 2018 reference
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "brain imaging data were collected using a 3T Siemens Prisma scanner (Siemens, Erlangen, Germany)"
rci1_using_msad.location: Lee2025.pdf.md: Methods / Data acquisition, L61; Somerville et al. 2018 (ref [27]) describes HCP-D as multi-site

rci2_using_epd.detail: HCP-D (Lifespan Human Connectome Project Development) used as the sole reference cohort for normative model construction
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "To construct a normative developmental trajectory, we used an additional cohort of 652 neurologically healthy children and adolescents from the Lifespan Human Connectome Project Development (HCP-D) dataset [27]."

rci3_epd_name.detail: HCP-D (Lifespan Human Connectome Project Development), a variant of HCP

rci5_n.detail: Training phase; 652 neurologically healthy TD from HCP-D used for normative model construction; the model was then transferred to ABIDE TD with intercept re-estimation
rci5_n.supporting_text: "we used an additional cohort of 652 neurologically healthy children and adolescents from the Lifespan Human Connectome Project Development (HCP-D) dataset" ... "A normative model for the gradient values was constructed using the HCP-D dataset and then transferred to the TD group of the ABIDE dataset."
rci5_n.location: Lee2025.pdf.md: Methods / Study participants, L57; Methods / Normative modeling, L81

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase HCP-D; paper reports 301 males and 251 females (sum=552), but total N is stated as 652; discrepancy of 100 participants unaccounted for; percentages calculated against reported total N=652; female_pct + male_pct = 84.7% due to this discrepancy
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "These participants (aged 5-21 years [14.44 ± 4.06, mean ± standard deviation], 301 males and 251 females)"

rci7_age.detail: Training phase HCP-D; age in years; mean and SD directly reported; range from methods section (abstract states 5-22 but methods specifies 5-21 for HCP-D participants)
rci7_age.supporting_text: "These participants (aged 5-21 years [14.44 ± 4.06, mean ± standard deviation], 301 males and 251 females)"
